platform: Windows; NVIDIA RTX 3070 Laptop / Ampere; driver 32.0.15.7247
scope: Isolated original upgrade branch; concurrent shot-planner and road rendering changes excluded. Mobile viewport/touch emulation uses desktop Chromium.

unitTests.setup: Frozen pnpm install plus separate COPC reader dependencies; exact Git bytes restored for two Lidingo source GeoJSON files affected by Windows newline conversion.

expectedDifferences: Realistic sky parity fails because r186 disables fog on SkyMesh and improves clouds. The owner asked to retain visual improvements.
The old r185 realistic sky fails the sky-only shading gate (flat fog colour); r186 passes.
existingFailure: check-app --only=puttom: 17 of 72 tee markers not on tee grass, also reported on r185/main.

software.capture: V3D.prepareCapture() then canvas.toDataURL() in the same browser task; ordinary compositor screenshot timed out.
software.scope: Puttom hole 1 tee, high quality, default golden light, 960 x 540. This does not reproduce the earlier Linux/browser combination.
